name: Thread Walker
description: You move between the physical and spiritual worlds with unnatural ease, your senses sharp in both.
effect: +4 Dexterity and +4 Wisdom at character creation.
ai_instruction: Add 4 to character Dexterity and 4 to character Wisdom during character creation. Narrate as a dual awareness — the body moves like water while the mind reads the world between worlds.
